using ll = long long;

struct mincostflow {
  struct edge {
    int v;
    long long c;
    long long w;
    int r;
  };

  vector<vector<edge>> G;

  mincostflow(int n) : G(n) {}

  void add(int u, int v, long long c, long long w) {
    int i = G[u].size();
    int j = G[v].size();
    G[u].push_back({v, c, w, j});
    G[v].push_back({u, 0, -w, i});
  }

  long long run(int s, int t, long long f) {
    const int N = G.size();
    long long res = 0;
    const long long INF = 1e18;
    vector<int> PE(N), PV(N);
    while (f > 0) {
      vector<long long> D(N, INF);
      vector<bool> inq(N, false);
      queue<int> q;
      D[s] = 0;
      q.push(s);
      inq[s] = true;
      while (!q.empty()) {
        int u = q.front(); q.pop(); inq[u] = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < G[u].size(); i++) {
          edge &e = G[u][i];
          if (e.c > 0 && D[e.v] > D[u] + e.w) {
            D[e.v] = D[u] + e.w;
            PV[e.v] = u;
            PE[e.v] = i;
            if (!inq[e.v]) {
              q.push(e.v);
              inq[e.v] = true;
            }
          }
        }
      }
      if (D[t] == INF) return -1;
      long long d = f;
      for (int i = t; i != s; i = PV[i]) {
        d = min(d, G[PV[i]][PE[i]].c);
      }
      f -= d;
      res += d * D[t];
      for (int i = t; i != s; i = PV[i]) {
        edge &e = G[PV[i]][PE[i]];
        e.c -= d;
        G[i][e.r].c += d;
      }
    }
    return res;
  }
};

  ll N, M, K, C, D;
  cin >> N >> M >> K >> C >> D;

    return res;
